# Canvas — full AI reference

Canvas generates documents two ways: a declarative **design JSON** (`DesignExportDto`) posted to the API,
or imperative **C# code** (`Canvas.Pdf`). This file is a snapshot derived from the element catalog
(`ui-designer-v2/src/docs/elementCatalog.ts`) and the API. Validate generated design JSON against
`docs/schema/design-export.schema.json` before posting.

## The generate → validate → render loop

1. Build a `DesignExportDto` (or `Canvas.Pdf` C#).
2. Validate the JSON against `docs/schema/design-export.schema.json` (required: `id`, `name`, `pages`;
   each element needs `id`, `type` (from the enum below), `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`).
3. Render: `POST /api/templates/render-design` (raw design → PDF) or `POST /api/export`
   (`{ design, format, data? }` → pdf/docx/html/xlsx/…). For C#: `POST /api/templates/csharp-code-to-pdf`.

## DesignExportDto shape

```
{ id, name, category?, description?,
  pages: [ { id, elements: [ <element> ] } ],
  sharedElements?: [ <element> ],   // repeated on every page (headers/footers/watermarks)
  pageSettings?: { width, height, orientation: "portrait"|"landscape", unit: "px"|"pt"|"mm"|"cm"|"in",
                   backgroundColor? } }
```

Common element fields (every element): `id`, `type`, `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`, `name?`, `hidden?`,
`locked?`, `style?` (CSS-like map), `binding?` (data path), `expression?` (template expression),
`visibleExpression?`. Style keys: `fontSize, fontFamily, fontWeight, fontStyle, color, textAlign,
backgroundColor, borderColor, borderWidth, borderRadius, padding, lineHeight, opacity, rotation`.

## Data binding & expressions

- Tokens: any content may contain `{{path.to.field}}`, filled from the `data` payload at render time.
- Expressions (`element.expression`): `$iif(cond,a,b)`, `$concat(...)`, `$coalesce(...)`,
  `$switch(c1,v1,...,default?)`, aggregates `$sum/$avg/$min/$max/$count/$first/$last` over a dataset or
  `$group` (2nd arg may be a field name OR a per-row expression, e.g. `$sum(Orders,"Qty * Price")`),
  operators `&& || ?? == != < <= > >= + - * / %` (`&&`/`||`/`??` short-circuit).
- Repeats: `element.repeat = { dataPath }` renders once per row; with `style.groupField` set, once per group
  and `$group` is the current group's rows (so a footer `$sum($group,"Amount")` is a per-group subtotal).

## Element types (type enum)

text, image, shape, table, line, qrcode, barcode, signature, richtext, field, textarea, checkbox, rect,
circle, chart, subsection, area, button, dropdown, optionlist, radio, watermark, note, arrow, draw, date,
highlight, checkmark, pageboundary, pagenumber, link, number, toc, footnote, endnote, bookmark, comment,
contentcontrol.

### Text
- **text** [PDF/Word/HTML/Excel] — static text. Props: `content`, `headingLevel?` (1–3, for TOC).
- **richtext** [PDF/Word/HTML] — inline HTML. Props: `htmlContent`.
- **date** [all] — static/render/binding date. Props: `dateMode`, `dateFormat`, `locale`, `timezone`, `fallbackText`.
- **pagenumber** [PDF/Word/HTML] — page number. Props: `numberingFormat` (current|total|pageOfTotal|roman|alphabetic), `startNumber`, `prefix`, `suffix`.
- **number** [PDF/Word/HTML] — formatted number. Props: `numberValue`, `numberStyle` (decimal|currency|percent|scientific|ordinal), `numberDecimals`, `numberCurrency`, `numberLocale`.
- **toc** [PDF/Word/HTML] — table of contents. Props: `tocTitle`, `tocShowPageNumbers`, `tocShowLeaderDots`, `tocMinLevel`, `tocMaxLevel`, `tocPlacement`.
- **footnote** / **endnote** [PDF/Word/HTML] — notes. Props: `footnoteText`, `footnoteRef?`.

### Form
- **field** [PDF/Word/HTML] — single-line text field. Props: `fieldLabel`, `fieldName`, `placeholder`, `required`.
- **textarea** [PDF/Word/HTML] — multi-line field. Props: `fieldName`, `placeholder`.
- **checkbox** [PDF/Word/HTML] — checkbox. Props: `fieldName`, `checkState` (checked|cross|dot|empty).
- **radio** [PDF/Word/HTML] — radio group. Props: `options[]`, `selectedValue`.
- **dropdown** [PDF/Word/HTML] — combo box. Props: `options[]`, `selectedValue`, `fieldName`.
- **optionlist** [PDF/Word/HTML] — bulleted/numbered list. Props: `options[]`, `ordered`, `listStyle`.
- **button** [PDF/Word/HTML] — button. Props: `content`, `buttonAction` (URL or "page:N").
- **signature** [PDF/Word/HTML] — signature line. Props: `signatureLabel`.

### Visual
- **image** [all] — raster/vector image. Props: `content` (URL/data URI), `fitMode` (contain|cover|fill|none), `preserveAspectRatio`, crop fields.
- **qrcode** [all] — QR code. Props: `qrValue`, `qrSize`.
- **barcode** [all] — linear barcode. Props: `barcodeValue`, `barcodeType` (Code128|EAN13|UPCA|Code39).
- **chart** [PDF/HTML] — bar/line/pie. Props: `chartType`, `chartData` ({ labels, datasets }).

### Shapes & Layout
- **shape**/**rect** [all] — filled/stroked rectangle. Style: backgroundColor, borderColor, borderWidth.
- **circle** [all] — ellipse. Style: backgroundColor/border.
- **line** [all] — divider line. Style: borderColor/borderWidth.
- **arrow** [PDF/Word/HTML] — arrow. Props: `arrowMode`, `startMarker`, `endMarker`.
- **draw** [PDF/Word/HTML] — freehand SVG. Props: `drawTool`, `pathData`.
- **table** [all] — grid. Props: `cellData[][]`, `columnWidths[]`, `columnAlignments[]`, `headerRow`, `footerRow`, `zebraEnabled`, `cellStyles[]`, `repeat?`.
- **subsection** / **area** / **pageboundary** [designer-only guides, not rendered to output].
- **highlight** [PDF/Word/HTML] — highlight rectangle. Props: `markMode`.
- **checkmark** [PDF/Word/HTML] — static check/cross/dot. Props: `checkState`.

### Document
- **watermark** [PDF/Word/HTML] — text/image watermark. Props: `content`, `watermarkMode`, `pageScope` (current|all|first|last|range|odd|even), `pageRange`.
- **note** [PDF/Word/HTML] — sticky note. Props: `noteTitle`, `noteBody`, `noteAuthor`.
- **link** [PDF/Word/HTML] — hyperlink. Props: `content`, `href`, `linkTarget`.
- **bookmark** [PDF/Word/HTML] — named anchor. Props: `bookmarkName`, `bookmarkTarget`.
- **comment** [PDF/Word/HTML] — review comment. Props: `commentAuthor`, `commentText`, `commentDate`.
- **contentcontrol** [PDF/Word/HTML] — Word SDT. Props: `contentControlType`, `contentControlTag`, `contentControlTitle`.

## Canvas.Pdf C# API (essentials)

```csharp
using Canvas.Pdf;
var document = new PdfDocument();              // AddPage(), AddPage(PdfPagePreset.Letter), AddPage(width,height)
document.Info.Title = "Report";
var page = document.AddPage();
page.DrawText("Title", x: 40, y: 800, new PdfDrawTextOptions { FontSize = 18, Bold = true });
page.DrawParagraph("Body…", x: 40, y: 770, maxWidth: 380);
page.DrawRectangle(x: 40, y: 720, width: 200, height: 40, lineWidth: 1, fill: true, fillColor: new PdfColor(0.93,0.95,1));
page.DrawImage("logo.png", x: 40, y: 660, width: 120, height: 50);
page.DrawSimpleTable(x: 40, y: 620, width: 360, rows: new[] { new[]{"Item","Qty"}, new[]{"Coffee","2"} });
page.AddWebLink(x: 40, y: 600, width: 80, height: 16, url: "https://example.com");
document.AddPageNumbers();
document.AddTextWatermark("DRAFT", new PdfWatermarkOptions { RotationDegrees = -45, Opacity = 0.15 });
byte[] pdf = document.ToBytes();
```

Colors: `new PdfColor(r,g,b)` (0–1), `new PdfGrayColor(v)`, `new PdfCmykColor(c,m,y,k)`. Full reference:
`docs/csharp-cookbook.md` + the DocFX API site (`docs/README.md`).

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/templates/render-design` — raw `DesignExportDto` → PDF.
- `POST /api/export` — `{ design, format, data? }` → file (pdf|docx|html|xlsx|csv|md|odt|svg|png|jpeg|tiff).
- `POST /api/templates/validate` — validate without rendering.
- `POST /api/templates/csharp-code-to-pdf` — compile `Canvas.Pdf` C# → PDF.
- `POST /api/templates/csharp-to-json` / `csharp-code-to-json` — C# → DesignExportDto JSON.
- `GET  /api/export/formats` — list export formats.
- Full HTTP surface: `docs/schema/openapi.json`.
